    s.Season, 
    t.Away_team, 
    COALESCE(g.Game_Count, 0) AS Game_Count
FROM 
    (SELECT DISTINCT Season FROM game) s
CROSS JOIN 
    (SELECT DISTINCT Away_team FROM game) t
LEFT JOIN 
    (SELECT Season, Away_team, COUNT(*) AS Game_Count FROM game GROUP BY Season, Away_team) g
ON 
    s.Season = g.Season AND t.Away_team = g.Away_team
ORDER BY 
    s.Season ASC, t.Away_team ASC;
